title: The Tempered Frame Course
summary: A course for Warriors that builds the whole frame into one heavy piece which crashes into a foe and holds a hardened weave against blows.

title: A Manual of Blow-Taking Conditioning
summary: A manual of conditioning that teaches the body to take blows on the muscle and bone and turn the force back on the striker.

title: The Sinew and Tendon Course
summary: A course on training the sinew and tendon to carry whip-fast blows and quick turns without tearing.

title: Course of the Breathing Furnace
summary: A course on stoking the body with breath and qi until it runs hot and strong and can sweat out foul humours.

title: The Healer's Knitting Course
summary: A course for those who tend the hurt that mends torn muscle and cracked bone and draws poison out of the blood.

title: The Joint-Locking Manual
summary: A manual of wrenching holds that use the whole body to lock a foe's joints and throw him off his feet.

title: The Charging Body Course
summary: A course in turning the body into a ram that closes the gap fast and breaks the foe's footing on arrival.

title: A Course in Reading the Body
summary: A course on reading the weight and the tension of a foe's body to answer before the blow arrives.
